title: Chapter 345 - 345 A Beautiful Woman Should Wear Beautiful Clothes; Crying! (2)
content:
Chapter 345 - 345 A Beautiful Woman Should Wear Beautiful Clothes; Crying! (2)

Chapter 345 - 345 A Beautiful Woman Should Wear Beautiful Clothes; Crying! (2)

345 A Beautiful Woman Should Wear Beautiful Clothes; Crying! (2)

However… Huang Ling’s voice quickly interrupted his imagination. “No need.”

Guo Zixiang was not angry and said, “You don’t have to be polite with me, pretty lady.”

At this moment, a crisp sound came from the entrance of the shop.

“She’s not being polite. If she likes it, I’ll buy it for her.”

This voice belonged to Lin Fan.

Qiu Ziqian’s and Huang Ling’s eyes lit up when they heard that.

Then, they rushed forward and hugged Lin Fan’s arm tightly. They said happily, “Lin Fan!”

If it were in the past, Huang Ling would have been more reserved.

She would not hug Lin Fan with Qiu Ziqian in a crowded place.

However, after not seeing him for a while, Qiu Ziqian’s longing for Lin Fan reached an uncontrollable level.

Therefore, she could not care less.

Seeing this…

Guo Zixiang froze.

W-What was going on?

These two beauties actually had a boyfriend!

Moreover, it seemed to be the same person!

Why?

Why?

Lin Fan did not care about that. He turned to the salesperson and said, “Help me wrap up all the clothes that they took a fancy to just now.”

When Huang Ling and Qiu Zi heard this, they immediately felt as if they had eaten candy.

The salesperson was a little stunned and said, “T-There are a total of eight pieces of clothing. Do you want all of them?”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.”

“Yes, Sir,” the salesperson said excitedly.

Eight pieces of clothing for less than 200,000 yuan. What a bargain!

Lin Fan took out his bank card.

Beep!

After a soft sound, the receipt appeared.

At the same time, 19 red packets appeared in Lin Fan’s phone.

Then, Lin Fan held Huang Ling’s left hand and Qiu Ziqian’s right hand as they walked out together.

Only Guo Zixiang was left, holding a piece of clothing that cost 28,999 yuan. He was stunned.

The salesperson beside him saw that he had been standing in the shop without moving. She could not help but ask, “Sir, do you need any more help?”

Guo Zixiang came back to his senses and waved his hand repeatedly. “No, no, no. No need.”

Then, he walked out of Chanel.

At this moment, Guo Zixiang’s stomach growled.

He glanced at the barbecue restaurant in front of him and walked in.

Perhaps it was because he had just spent tens of thousands of yuan and had not succeeded in hitting on a beautiful woman, he wanted to eat something to vent his anger.

Perhaps it was because he had become a super-rich tycoon, so he wanted to indulge in high-quality beef.

Therefore, Guo Zixiang ordered a lot of dishes for this meal.

He was very satisfied.

Guo Zixiang burped and wiped the grease from the corner of his mouth. “Waiter, the bill, please!”

“Hello, that’s 799 yuan in total,” the waiter said.

In the past, Guo Zixiang’s heart would definitely hurt if he spent 799 yuan on a meal.

Today, he was very relaxed.

After all, he was now a super-rich tycoon.

Hence, he casually took out his bank card.

The waiter took the bank card and gently swiped it on the POS machine, but soon, there was an urgent series of beeps.

“I’m sorry, but your bank card has insufficient funds,” the waiter said.

“Insufficient funds?” Guo Zixiang frowned. “How is that possible?”

However, he quickly remembered that he only had 46,000 yuan on his card.

He had just used 45,888 yuan to buy a Chanel dress. It seemed normal that his card had insufficient funds.

Then, Guo Zixiang took out his phone and looked at his WeChat balance—1.3 yuan.

He could not help but cough and say, “Uhh… Waiter, wait a moment. I’ll make a call first.”

“Alright,” the waiter replied.

After saying that, he walked to the side.

However, the waiter’s eyes were fixed on Guo Zixiang.

It was obvious that he was trying to prevent him from escaping.

Guo Zixiang did not notice this. He dialed his father’s number directly.

After two rings, the call was connected.

“Zixiang, why are you calling?” His father’s slightly hoarse voice came from the phone. At the same time, there was a dull rumble.

“Dad, what’s that sound?” Guo Zixiang asked.

“Didn’t I say yesterday that a gold mine was discovered in the mountains? So the machines are here to mine!” Guo An said. As he spoke, he spat out a mouthful of thick phlegm.

Guo Zixiang had never liked his father spitting. He thought it was very disgusting.

However, at this moment, he thought he heard the sound of nature.

He… He was finally going to become a super-rich tycoon!

“Really?” Guo Zixiang said excitedly. “They’re already here to mine? Dad, transfer me a few hundred thousand yuan first.”

“What? What did you say, you son of a b*tch?!” Guo An shouted.

Guo Zixiang said, “Transfer me a few hundred thousand! Since we’ve found a gold mine, our family should get at least tens of millions, right?”

“Who told you that we’re going to get tens of millions?!” Guo An shouted. “Bullsh*t! What does it have to do with us that someone else discovered a gold mine?”

Guo Zixiang was stunned for a moment and said, “D-Didn’t Grandpa say that the mountains belong to our family?”

“Your grandfather also said that he was a commander in the past!” Guo An shouted. “He was just a soldier on the front lines!”

Guo Zixiang’s heart turned slightly cold. Immediately after, he said, “But… But didn’t our family use to farm in the mountains?”

Guo An sneered. “I’ve pooped in the park before. Does that mean the park is mine too? Is there anything else?” Guo An asked. “If there’s nothing else, I’ll go and look at the excavators!”

After saying that, he hung up the phone.

Guo Zixiang held his phone and was in a daze.

No…

There was no gold mine in his family.

He was no longer a super-rich tycoon.

There was nothing else.

Everything was gone.

When he slowly lowered his head and saw the Chanel dress that he had spent 45,888 yuan on, his eyes turned slightly red as he started crying.

At this moment, the waiter walked over and said, “Excuse me, sir. Are you going to pay now?”

…

Lin Fan, Qiu Ziqian, and Huang Ling had no idea what Guo Zixiang had experienced.

The three of them chatted as they shopped. They were very relaxed and happy.

When they left the mall, they bought 20 pieces of clothing, six pairs of shoes, and three bags. It was a fruitful trip.

At night, Lin Fan brought Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling to Tribute Garden Restaurant.

Dozens of waiters had already lined up in two rows to welcome them.

The luxurious private room was filled with rose petals and swaying candlelight, forming a big heart. On the huge dining table, there were many tempting delicacies and wine.

When the three of them walked into the room, fireworks exploded outside the French windows, forming a dazzling heart shape.

Flowers, delicacies, wine, fireworks… It was like a dream.

Qiu Ziqian’s and Huang Ling’s beautiful eyes flickered along with the candlelight.

This meal was filled with happiness.

When Lin Fan brought Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling back to Yi Ke City…

Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling could not hold themselves back anymore and pounced into Lin Fan’s embrace.

This night was destined to be sleepless.

…

After that, Lin Fan stayed in Yi Ke City for two days.

It was not until the third day that he returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He sat on the soft sofa and looked at the 302 red packets on the screen. He muttered, “302? Let’s see what I can get.

“Open them all!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained two yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 888 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a car—Cullinan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 334 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

…

The 302 red packets were obtained by spending 3.02 million yuan.

After opening these red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 89,112 yuan, a Cullinan, and a one yuan critical hit card.

Cullinan’s price was nine million.

As for the one yuan critical hit card, he could earn 100 million yuan if he spent one yuan!

Regarding this… Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all.

He was still sitting on the sofa and playing with his phone.

After two days of hard work…

That night, Lin Fan slept very comfortably and soundly.
